name: dai-scope-real-chain

mounts.source: <replace: artifacts dir holding daiorama-tests + run output>

command: exec > /out/scope-real-chain.txt 2>&1; cd /out; dbus-run-session -- ./daiorama-tests real_containment_chain --ignored --nocapture --test-threads=1; echo exit=$?; echo '== nsroot subtree_control after =='; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control; echo '== daiorama-sessions contents =='; ls -la /sys/fs/cgroup/daiorama-sessions 2>&1; echo '== keeper procs =='; wc -l /sys/fs/cgroup/keeper/cgroup.procs 2>&1; echo RUN-DONE
